meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标分解成有依据的执行步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把复杂目标拆成可执行的步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Break down goals into evidence-bound steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn complex goals into actionable steps.

howto.what: 把大目标拆成极细步骤,每步绑定真实可查的证据(如终端输出、浏览器结果),持续更新计划清单;代码类工作委派给子代理,后台跟踪进度。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词,或要求进行持久目标执行、证据主导的工作、手动QA、检查点式长期交付时触发。

say.text: 用ulw-loop把“上线新功能”拆成可验证步骤
say.note: 它会注册目标并分解执行。

say.text: 开启ulw模式,按证据驱动完成这个报告
say.note: 它按证据链逐项产出并记录。

say.text: 用检查点方式执行这个长期任务,每步手动QA
say.note: 它会在每阶段留下证据并继续。

howto.what_en: Breaks a large goal into ultra-granular, evidence-bound steps, keeps a live plan checklist, delegates code work to subagents, and tracks progress with real-surface evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break 'ship the new feature' into verifiable steps
say_en.note: It registers the goal and decomposes it.

say_en.text: Run ulw mode and complete this report evidence-driven
say_en.note: It produces each item with recorded evidence.

say_en.text: Execute this long task with checkpoints and manual QA per step
say_en.note: It captures evidence at each phase and continues.
